Mansfield options

Forest Hills lists adult walking and riding prices and allows drop-in play, while also offering online booking. Twin Lakes asks golfers to call for current pricing; Oak Tree uses its booking page.

Bellville options

Deer Ridge and Little Apple are in Bellville, south of Mansfield. Deer Ridge’s fixed prices are not reproduced here; Little Apple is an executive-length option with date-specific booking prices.

Bellville, OH

Deer Ridge Golf Club

Confirm current rates

Use the official rate page or booking page to confirm the price for your round; no fixed green-fee table is reproduced here. Deer Ridge is an eighteen-hole public course in Bellville with tree-lined holes and elevation changes. Check the official scorecard when planning your round. The official course page states a 3% convenience fee on credit-card sales. Confirm the final charge and applicable terms before paying.
